title: hieracium pocuticum subsp. klopotivae
intro: Hieracium pocuticum subsp. klopotivae, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds may contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations.
